text.p: Finnish mobile phone maker Nokia's 9000 Communicator -- which combines a mobile phone with a palmtop computer -- features for free in the film 'The Saint' launching in Europe and due to open in Finland in May.

A Nokia spokeswoman confirmed a report in daily Ilta-Sanomat on Tuesday that the company has not paid anything for the publicity: lead character Simon Templar, played by actor Val Kilmer, carries the Communicator with him throughout the film.
The Communicator has been available in Europe since last year and is about to be launched in the United States.
"The movie will certainly help (sales) already due to its volume," the paper quoted Nokia mobile phones marketing director Heikki Norta as saying.
